275002137.description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

282261125.description:
Polished Stone Eggs Lot - 9 Pieces
Decorative Mineral & Alabaster Carvings
Collection of nine carved and polished stone decorative eggs featuring diverse natural minerals, alabaster, and brecciated stone patterns. Popular as mid-century to late-20th-century decorative accents, polished stone eggs showcase individual mineral veining, color banding, and smooth high-gloss finishes suitable for display bowls, baskets, or stands.
Items Included:
Pale yellow polished alabaster egg
Bright orange veined stone egg with surface chip
Seafoam green and white mottled stone egg
Brown and tan swirl-patterned marble egg
Rich red-orange veined marble egg
Honey-brown speckled mineral egg
Terracotta and cream banded stone egg
Pink brecciated mosaic stone egg with inclusions
Pink brecciated mosaic stone egg with inclusions
Condition:
One orange egg features a distinct surface chip with exposed white stone. Remaining eight eggs exhibit smooth polished surfaces with minor surface scuffs, natural stone fissures, and light display wear consistent with age. No stands included.

Scout Curated Wears Tree of Life Suncatcher
Amethyst Tree of Protection Figurine & Window Prism
Faceted Glass Crystal & Brass Wire, 5 Inches Tall

Configured as the Tree of Protection, the piece features natural amethyst chips and faceted crystal beads woven across gold-tone brass wire branches. The tree is anchored to a heavy multi-faceted clear crystal sphere designed to cast vibrant rainbow light across interior living spaces when placed in direct sunlight.
Handcrafted brass wire tree with natural amethyst and crystal accent beads
Weighted multi-faceted glass crystal prism base measuring 1.25 inches across
Measures approximately 5 inches in total standing height
Complete with original Scout Curated Wears cylindrical storage container
Condition:
Glass crystal base is clear and free of cracks, chips, or scratches. Wire armature and gemstone chips are intact with no loose or missing elements. Storage cylinder is structurally sound with light handling wear along the cardboard rim.
